anomalies.observed: The netlist inserts U5, a 74LVC1G34 buffer, between the MCU and the NFC SCL bus: U2 pin 61 (PB8) is connected only to U5 pin 2 on Net-(U5-Pad2), while U5 pin 4 drives NFC_SCL together with R2 and U3 pin 3. U2 pin 61 is not a node on NFC_SCL.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, NFC_SCL is a direct net from U2 pin 61 (PB8) to R2 and U3 pin 3 (SCL), with no intermediate buffer.

anomalies.impact: The MCU no longer drives the I2C SCL line directly; the SCL line is driven through a push-pull buffer whose input has no pull-up. This breaks the intended open-drain I2C topology and can cause undefined SCL levels or NFC communication failure.
